project_info.theme: Corolla Cross Hybrid as a connected family space
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, white, leafy green, black, soft beige

main_subject.detail: A bright family-home lifestyle poster with the title 'COROLLA CROSS HYBRID GOI TRON BINH YEN TINH CHON KHONG GIAN KET NOI'. A white Corolla Cross Hybrid is shown in side profile parked in front of modern houses. A child sits inside the rear seat smiling and holding up a toy plane. At the rear, a mother holding grocery bags walks by while a father closes the open tailgate. Trees and modern home facades fill the background.
main_subject.style: Warm suburban family-lifestyle automotive poster with natural daylight, gentle storytelling, and clean premium framing
